ms.text:
MP1
Apparatus: forcemeter or pulley and weights arrangement
MP2
Pull box up slope. Measure force and distance moved
MP3
Repeat with different masses
MP4
Key variable: angle of slope (or height of blocks, owtte)
MP5
Key variable: Distance moved
MP6
Table with columns for force and mass with correct units
MP7
Calculate work done and compare with mass.
OR, if there is a work done column in the table, compare work done with mass
OR plot a graph of work done against mass
